issues.claim: "It runs on the existing listing database and CRM login." (Why this works) and "broker-side CRM login" framing
issues.problem: The public site does have a username/password broker login (form action /login.asp), but nothing publicly identifies that system as a CRM. The audit states it as fact rather than as the researcher's inference.
issues.fix: Say "the existing listing database and the broker login on the site, subject to a discovery check that it is the firm's CRM" — or drop the word CRM from the audit body.

issues.claim: "The contact page offers 23 broker mobiles and one admin extension; the one structured form is seller-side (property valuation)."
issues.problem: The valuation form is not on the contact page — it is an iframe on the home page (whatismypropertyworth.asp), reached from the "What Is Your Property Worth?" box. Read quickly, the sentence implies the form sits on the contact page. The same form also carries a "Space Needed (sf)" field, so "seller-side" is a fair summary of the page copy but not the whole form.
issues.fix: Rewrite as: "the contact page is a directory and a main number only; the site's one structured form is an owner-side property valuation request on the home page."

issues.claim: "You are hiring a full-time marketing/admin assistant at $42,000–$50,000 for brochures, flyers, research and press"
issues.problem: The cited Indeed page (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Bussel-Realty-Corp) is blocked to re-checking (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare block in a real browser), so the duty list (brochures, flyers, research, press) could not be re-opened and confirmed. The salary and location are independently visible in two job-board index copies (Glassdoor and SimplyHired both show a Bussel Realty Corp Marketing / Administrative Assistant, Edison NJ, $42,000–$50,000, full-time), so only the duty list is unverified.
issues.fix: Add one openable job-board link alongside Indeed (e.g. the Glassdoor or SimplyHired copy of the posting) and keep the duty wording close to the posting text, or soften to "brochures, flyers and marketing content".

issues.claim: "bussel.com/contact-us/ returns a raw IIS error page." (email draft)
issues.problem: Accurate but "IIS" is server jargon for a non-technical founder in a cold email; the walk-in line already uses the plainer phrase.
issues.fix: In the email, say "returns a raw server error page" and keep IIS for the audit body if at all.

issues.claim: Sources list: "#26961 — exclusive listing printing a street address (Prestige Plaza, 334 Roue 31, Flemington)"
issues.problem: Not wrong — the page literally prints "334 Roue 31" — but it is the site's own misspelling of Route 31 and will look like a transcription error by us.
